response.sql: SELECT store_id, AVG(total_payment) AS avg_per_rental_total, AVG(payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental FROM (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS payment_count FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE p.amount >= 4.99 GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id) rental_totals GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
